description: Behaviour cases for retrieval-engineering-designer (6 domain-specific cases).

cases.prompt: Design our semantic retrieval stack: chunking, embeddings, fusion and reranking.

assertions: Produces a retrieval design table with trade-offs and an evaluation plan.

cases.prompt: Retrieval quality dropped - design the relevance evaluation plan and regression gate.

assertions: Defines golden-set source, metrics, thresholds and a regression gate.
States no live evaluation was run.

cases.prompt: We have no golden set for relevance - design the retrieval evaluation approach.

assertions: Plans golden-set construction with strata and labelling rules.

cases.prompt: Rag security architect work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Decide chunking and embedding strategy for our documentation corpus.

assertions: Recommends chunking and embedding choices for the documentation corpus with trade-offs (quality, cost, latency).
Names the index configuration and the evaluation needed to confirm the chunking/embedding choices.

cases.prompt: Design hybrid dense/lexical retrieval and reranking with failure-mode analysis.

assertions: Characterizes corpus and query intents before choosing components.
States unknowns and the evaluation needed to confirm choices.
